parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the double-angle formula and obtain an equation in $\sin\theta$ - M1. Reduce to $6\sin^2\theta+\sin\theta-5=0$, or a three-term equivalent - A1. Solve the quadratic in $\sin\theta$ and calculate $\theta$ - M1. Obtain $56.4^\circ$ - A1. Obtain $123.6^\circ$ and $270^\circ$, and no others in the interval - A1; ignore outside answers and treat radians as a misread. Printed total: 5.
